City of Inglewood
  Finance Department
  (310) 412-5257

  MINUTES
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  December 09, 2019

A meeting of the Claims Review Committee was held in the Small Executive Conference
Room, 9th floor at 11:37 a.m.:

  Members Present: Yvonne Horton, City Clerk Department
  Wanda Brown, City Treasurer Department
  Maria Heaney, Finance Department
  Ken Campos, Legal Department

  Staff Present:  Mindy Wilcox, Planning Department
  Herd, Micah, Police Department
  Lori Jones, Housing

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
  Maria Heaney reported no public comments.

  1. The minutes of November 18, 2019, meeting was approved as recorded.

  2. ALH Urban and Regional Economics – Executive session to discuss recommended
  payment for providing analytical services for Entertainment Center in the amount of $4,
  365.18. Motion carried unanimously.

  3. Bevel, Gardner and Associates, Inc. – Executive session to discuss recommended
  payment for providing analysis for complex scenes and crime processing in the amount
  of $1,000.00. Motion carried unanimously.

  4. Park View Motel - Executive session to discuss recommended payment for emergency
  homeless shelter in the amount of $1,920.00. Motion carried unanimously.

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
  Maria Heaney reported no public comments.

  There being no further business, the meeting adjourned at 11:57 a.m. Adjournment
